description: Sustained-load thermal test of EmbeddingGemma 2 and Gemma 4 (E2B, E4B, 26B-A4B) alone on the GPU, split across GPU and RAM, and with several models resident on the GPU and in RAM at the same time. Merged from four invocations on 2026-10-10 (scenarios run as models finished downloading).

hardware.note: Measured on the host running the checks (backend container or CLI), which is not necessarily the embedding server.

scenarios.name: embeddinggemma-2-gpu
scenarios.description: EmbeddingGemma 2 Q8_0 alone on the GPU, 4 clients x 32 texts

scenarios.name: gemma4-e2b-gpu
scenarios.description: Gemma 4 E2B Q8_0 alone on the GPU, 4 concurrent chat clients

scenarios.name: gemma4-e4b-gpu
scenarios.description: Gemma 4 E4B Q8_0 alone on the GPU, 4 concurrent chat clients

scenarios.name: gemma4-26b-split
scenarios.description: Gemma 4 26B-A4B Q4_0, llama.cpp --fit decides how many layers stay in VRAM, rest in RAM

scenarios.name: gemma4-26b-cpu-moe
scenarios.description: Gemma 4 26B-A4B Q4_0 with attention on the GPU and all MoE experts in system RAM

scenarios.name: mixed-gpu-and-ram
scenarios.description: EmbeddingGemma 2 and Gemma 4 E2B resident on the GPU while Gemma 4 E4B runs from system RAM on the CPU, all three under load at the same time

scenarios.name: embeddinggemma-2-gpu-run1-cold
scenarios.description: Same scenario, very first run of the evening (GPU 66 C at start, no downloads running); result schema predates the weight-buffer fields
